query:
SELECT isrc,
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        MIN(title) AS title,
        MIN(artist) AS artist,
        MIN(album) AS album
        FROM tracks
        WHERE isrc IS NOT NULL AND isrc != '' AND marked_for_deletion = 0
        GROUP BY isrc
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
            AND COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(file_hash, CAST(id AS TEXT))) > 1
        ORDER BY n DESC, artist, album, title
